name: concord
description: Stay in control while AI agents write your code. A strong model turns each task into a short plan you approve and checks the result; low-cost models implement it inside a fixed file scope, against tests that must fail first; an independent reviewer checks every change at its risk level; you review the diff and commit. Adds /concord:plan-then-delegate, /concord:delegate and /concord:rules-review, plus implementer, reviewer and verifier agents. Needs the dispatcher from the repository's install.sh. Actively developed: new versions ship through this marketplace.
